title: SOC2 evidence scratchpad - daily
content:
Daily scratchpad — SOC2 evidence / vendor checks / policy TODOs

Quick log (03/03/2026):
- 09:15 sync w/ Evelyn: went through access-control checklist; still missing up-to-date screenshots for service account roles. Action: get console screenshots + CLI output.
- 10:40 vendor review: Okta request outstanding (need latest SOC2 type II). Sent follow-up email, cc: Legal. Ticket: SEC-214.
- 14:00 infra ask: retention config for logs (elk/stack) — need RPO/RTO statement for evidence bundle.

TODOs (prioritized):
- [ ] Capture IAM console screenshots (roles: redwood-inference-service, batch-runner) — include timestamps + redacted ARNs. (estimated 30m)
- [ ] Run `gcloud iam service-accounts list --format=json` and save output to evidence/service-accounts-YYYYMMDD.txt
- [ ] Add demonstration of MFA enforcement: screenshot of auth policy and policy ID (Confluence link above)
- [ ] Vendor follow-up: obtain Okta SOC2 report + encrypt + store in evidence/vendor/okta/ (SEC-214)
- [ ] Update Data Retention policy draft: section on embeddings retention (Evelyn assigned) — unresolved Q: recommended max retention window?
- [ ] Draft response for auditor question on change control (attach PRs and changelog snippet from infra repo)

Notes / fragments:
- Evidence naming convention: evidence/<control>-<YYYYMMDD>-<owner>.pdf (discuss w/ Priya re: consistent filenames)
- For screenshots, ensure browser devtools not exposing tokens; use incognito, wipe cookies.
- Possible ask for SRE: add short-lived presigned URLs to evidence bucket for auditors (expires 7d) — ticket to SRE team.

Open questions / blockers:
- Does Legal want the vendor report in encrypted Slack or Confluence? (ask Priya)
- Need confirmation on retention period for embeddings (product input) — ping product-hosted-api channel.

Quick links / refs:
- Jira: SEC-214, SEC-198 (change control)
- Confluence: Data Retention policy (draft)
- GH PR: infra#142 (changelog snippet for change-control evidence)

Tomorrow plan (03/04):
- Morning: take IAM screenshots and run CLI exports
- Midday: package Okta follow-up + escalate to Legal if no response by EOD
- Afternoon: start assembling evidence zip for access-control (include checklist.csv)

Notes to self: keep entries terse, timestamp every upload, and always include owner and command used to generate output.

Rough copy for auditor email (draft):
"Hi [Auditor], attached are the requested artifacts for Access Control (control AC-1/AC-2). Files are labeled with timestamps and owners. Please let me know if you need additional context or logs. Happy to schedule a short walkthrough."

-- Harper
